text: The paper reports that removing logical consistency from ICM only moderately worsens TruthfulQA results, because the degenerate same-label solution rarely occurs, whereas logical consistency is crucial on Alpaca, where the degenerate solution almost always happens without it.
title: Logical consistency matters on Alpaca but only moderately on TruthfulQA
